_comment: The source registry (docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md criterion 6). One row per source the graph publishes a figure or a piece of evidence from. data_pipeline/freshness.py re-derives every date on each build and refuses a row that does not re-adjudicate; the gate mirrors it. Edit rows here, never the derived block on the graph.
cadencesAre: the reviewer's statements of each publisher's cycle, with a basis beside each; none was read from a publisher's own schedule, and every lag and margin is to be tuned on the first update cycles

sources.label: Monthly Treasury Statement, Table 5 (outlays by agency)
sources.publisher: Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service (FiscalData)

cadence.basis: the statement for a month appears early in the next month, the September (fiscal year-end) statement later in October; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the statement's own record date: the last day of the month the statement reports

sources.label: USAspending File A gross outlays (toptier agencies and bureaus)
sources.publisher: Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service (USAspending.gov)

cadence.basis: agencies submit DATA Act files for each period in the following month and the site updates as they certify; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the date the fiscal-year-to-date figures were read, which is the period they run to

sources.label: USAspending File B obligations by object class
sources.publisher: Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service (USAspending.gov)

cadence.basis: a completed fiscal year's twelfth period is certified in the November after it ends; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the end of the completed fiscal year the obligations are for

sources.label: House Statement of Disbursements (quarterly)
sources.publisher: U.S. House of Representatives, Chief Administrative Officer

cadence.basis: published each quarter, about two months after the quarter ends (2 U.S.C. 104a, a section this project has not read); the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the last day of the quarter the statement covers

sources.label: Report of the Secretary of the Senate, Part II (committee accounts)
sources.publisher: U.S. Senate, Secretary of the Senate (via govinfo)

cadence.basis: a semiannual report (2 U.S.C. 4108, a section this project has not read), printed as a Senate document some months after the period; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the last day of the half-year the report covers

sources.label: OPM salary tables: Executive Schedule, General Schedule, SES, SL/ST
sources.publisher: Office of Personnel Management

cadence.basis: new tables take effect with the first pay period of January and OPM posts them around the pay-adjustment order in late December; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the tables' own effective date

sources.label: The pay-adjustment order's schedules, in the note to 5 U.S.C. 5332 (Schedules 5–8)
sources.publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, U.S. House

cadence.basis: a new executive order each late December, effective in January, reproduced in the Code's note when the Code is updated; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the order's own effective date

sources.label: Judicial Compensation table
sources.publisher: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts (uscourts.gov)

cadence.basis: the table adds the new year's row when judicial salaries adjust in January; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the effective date of the current row

sources.label: Senate salaries since 1789
sources.publisher: U.S. Senate (senate.gov)

cadence.basis: a row per year, added when the year's rate is set; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the effective date of the current row

sources.label: Annual Report to Congress on White House Office Personnel
sources.publisher: The White House Office

cadence.basis: Section 6 of Public Law 103-270 requires the report by July 1 each year (as the module reading it records)

copy.basis: the report's own as-of line, "Wednesday, July 1, 2026"
copy.meaning: the report's own as-of date

mustContain: Annual Report to Congress on White House Office Personnel

sources.label: OPM's current Plum Book export (PLUM Reporting)
sources.publisher: Office of Personnel Management (escs.opm.gov)

cadence.basis: a live export with no publication date of its own; it changes as agencies report

copy.meaning: the date the export was fetched

sources.label: OPM's Plum Book archive, previous administration
sources.publisher: Office of Personnel Management

cadence.basis: the archive covers January 21, 2021 – January 20, 2025 and is closed

copy.meaning: the last day of the period the archive covers

sources.label: FedScope civilian employment (headcount and average pay by agency)
sources.publisher: Office of Personnel Management

cadence.basis: March and September datasets, posted some months after the period; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the last day of the month the dataset counts

sources.label: The United States Government Manual
sources.publisher: Office of the Federal Register (via govinfo)

cadence.basis: an annual edition dated to the year's end, posted in the following months; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the edition's own date

sources.label: OMB Public Budget Database
sources.publisher: Office of Management and Budget (via govinfo)

cadence.basis: released with each President's Budget, due the first Monday in February (31 U.S.C. 1105(a), a section this project has not read) and often later; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the date the package was fetched; its last completed year is FY2025

sources.label: Statement of Net Cost (Financial Report of the U.S. Government)
sources.publisher: Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service (FiscalData)

cadence.basis: the audited Financial Report for a fiscal year appears the following February or March; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the statement's own date, the fiscal year's end

sources.label: Combined Statement of Receipts, Outlays, and Balances
sources.publisher: Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service

cadence.basis: published for each completed fiscal year, around the December after it ends; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the end of the completed fiscal year the statement covers

sources.label: Sections of the United States Code (pay, grade and establishment provisions)
sources.publisher: Office of the Law Revision Counsel; Government Publishing Office (govinfo)

cadence.basis: a section changes only when Congress amends it; the oldest copy in use is re-checked yearly

copy.meaning: the date the OLDEST section in use was fetched

sources.label: Federal Register agency directory
sources.publisher: Office of the Federal Register (federalregister.gov API)

cadence.basis: a live directory with no edition; re-checked twice a year

copy.meaning: the directory's fetch time, which every listing carries as checkedAt (the fixture wraps the API body with its own fetched_at and has no .meta.json)

sources.label: Senate committee membership lists (one XML file per committee)
sources.publisher: U.S. Senate (senate.gov)

cadence.basis: the lists change with each Congress and as subcommittees are reorganised; re-checked twice a year

copy.meaning: the date the lists were fetched

sources.label: House Clerk's committee list (ExcelCommitteeData)
sources.publisher: Clerk of the U.S. House of Representatives

cadence.basis: the list changes with each Congress and as subcommittees are reorganised; re-checked twice a year

copy.meaning: the date the list was fetched

sources.label: Federal Register documents' signature blocks (a census of two tranches)
sources.publisher: Office of the Federal Register (federalregister.gov)

cadence.basis: a census taken once; what it says about the documents in it does not age, and a new census is a new corpus

copy.meaning: the date the corpus was fetched

sources.label: USAJOBS vacancy announcements (a reviewed set, read for pay plan and grade)
sources.publisher: Office of Personnel Management (usajobs.gov)

cadence.basis: announcements close and are replaced; the set is re-checked twice a year

copy.meaning: the date the announcements were fetched

sources.label: U.S. Attorneys' Administratively Determined pay plan chart
sources.publisher: Department of Justice, Executive Office for U.S. Attorneys

cadence.basis: the chart is dated to a January effective date each year; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the chart's own effective date

sources.label: VA Title 38 physician, dentist and podiatrist pay ranges
sources.publisher: Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration

cadence.basis: a new table each January, effective with the first pay period; the reviewer's statement of the publisher's cycle, not read from a publisher's document; to be tuned on the first cycles

copy.meaning: the table's own effective date

sources.label: DOE's laboratory pages and 48 CFR part 970 (who operates each laboratory)
sources.publisher: Department of Energy; Government Publishing Office

cadence.basis: an operating model changes rarely; re-checked yearly

copy.meaning: the date the pages were fetched

sources.label: The organisations' own official pages (existence and placement evidence)
sources.publisher: each agency (.gov / .mil)

cadence.basis: a page can be reorganised at any time; a label read from it is re-checked twice a year

copy.meaning: the most recent date any page was read; each node's own panel uses its own lastVerified

sources.note: The pages themselves live in data/verification/evidence.json by URL, not as fixtures; the two fixtures here are the ones committed as examples. The per-node date is the node's own lastVerified, and the panel's recheck line uses it.
